status: mechanism test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and before vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims

hypotheses.kinematic_mixture: Repeatable whole-session vertical individuality is largely induced by stable individual differences in the proportions of broad speed × tortuosity modes.
hypotheses.within_kinematic_state: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even when self and other profiles are compared under identical 5-km cell × speed × turning-state weights.

state_definition.event_assignment: fix i is valid when both adjacent step intervals i-2->i-1 and i-1->i are positive and <=1800 s
state_definition.speed: horizontal Euclidean step distance for i-1->i divided by elapsed seconds
state_definition.turn_angle: absolute deflection angle between the two consecutive horizontal step vectors, in [0, pi]
state_definition.speed_threshold: cohort median of valid endpoint speeds
state_definition.turn_threshold: cohort median of valid absolute turn angles
state_definition.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session's median primary vertical coordinate computed from all retained numeric-height events before selecting valid kinematic endpoints

estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, kinematic state)
estimator.common_weighting: On joint 5-km cell × kinematic-state strata supported by both predictors, compute equal-session self training weights and apply exactly the same weights to self and other vertical profiles.
estimator.target_scoring: score centered residual-height outcomes at target kinematic endpoints whose joint strata are supported by both predictors

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived kinematic states
calibration.preserve: all within-session x-y-time-state-residual-z observations and exact original session-count multiset per label
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact expected evaluable n; observed-minus-null-mean common joint-cell-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

synthesis.primary_statistic: number of the five comparative panels passing the frozen kinematic-state-conditioned identity rule

decision_matrix.4_or_5_pass: Strong evidence that broad speed × tortuosity mixture alone is insufficient as a general explanation; individuality persists within kinematic states.
decision_matrix.2_or_3_pass: Mixed mechanism: kinematic-state composition may account for part of the pattern, while within-state individuality remains in some systems.
decision_matrix.0_or_1_pass: Consistent with broad kinematic-state composition explaining much of the comparative signal, subject to support/power loss.

synthesis.note: Report attenuation relative to the speed-only state-conditioned result descriptively; do not use attenuation ratios as inferential rescue.

claim_boundary: Speed × turning states are kinematic proxies, not validated commuting, foraging or social behavioural labels.
Persistence supports within-kinematic-state individuality relative to this proxy, not a specific morphology, memory, resource or atmospheric cause.
Loss after conditioning is not by itself proof of behavioural-mixture causation because richer conditioning reduces support.
No result from this extension modifies the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change the selected speed2_turn2 definition, dt cap, centering, bins, joint support, weighting, minimum scored events, expected n, panel B/seeds or pass criteria after any vertical output is opened.
Retain all non-passing panels and do not substitute the failed speed3_turn2 preflight candidate.
Do not add another post-hoc kinematic classifier if this frozen proxy fails.
